metadata.clock: primitive actions within three episodes, at most ten decisions per episode
metadata.unknown: fixed endpoint model low/high; all transitions, candidate likelihoods and safe reward supplied
metadata.actor_observation: position, remaining action budget, arrived reward and saved q; true theta unavailable
metadata.resets: first episode initialized at x=0; at most two resets restore position and budget only; theta and belief persist; no simulator queries by actor
